options.name: mgmt_vip
options.description:
The VMS Virtual IP. This is a virtual IP configured on the management interfaces on all CNodes. VAST Management
System (VMS) listens on this IP. It is used to access the VMS interfaces.

options.name: min_pwd_length
options.description: Minimum password length for new VMS managers

options.name: min_tls_version
options.description:
Minimum supported TLS version. By default, VMS does not allow TLS connections with TLS versions older than 1.2.
To loosen this restriction, set this property to a lower version value, such as 1.0 or 1.1.
